title: Sensex 2-Minute Scalping Strategy Using 10/20 EMA Crossover and Pullbacks
rule: Sensex 2-min Scalping: Long when 10 EMA > 20 EMA and Short when 10 EMA < 20 EMA, entering only on pullbacks with RSI(14) default filter.
entry: Enter on a price pullback/retracement toward 10/20 EMA when 10 EMA > 20 EMA (Long) or 10 EMA < 20 EMA (Short)
conditions: RSI(14) default settings active; do not chase breakout candles directly
data_needed: 2-min OHLC data for Sensex, 10 EMA, 20 EMA, RSI (14)

title: EMA Crossover with RSI >= 40 Framework for Swing and Positional Trading
rule: Daily 25/55 EMA Bullish Crossover + RSI >= 40 + Market Cap > 10,000 Cr Filter
entry: Buy when 25 EMA crosses above 55 EMA from below (or 20 EMA crosses above 50 EMA) AND RSI(14) >= 40 AND both EMAs are actively sloping upward (rising).
exit: Exit on Bearish EMA Crossover (25 EMA crosses below 55 EMA) OR when 1:2 Risk-Reward target is met OR trail stop-loss up 10% for every 10% gain.
stop: Set stop-loss at recent price action support level (swing low prior to the bullish crossover).
conditions: Market Cap > 10,000 Crore to ensure liquidity; reject trades if EMAs are flat/sideways despite RSI > 40.
data_needed: daily OHLC, market cap, RSI 14, EMA 25, EMA 55
